report.explanation: All admitted telemetry is healthy: checkout trace OK at 60ms, error rate 0.0014, p95 74ms, zero db pool waiters and dependency timeouts, and INFO/200 logs across gateway, order, and payment. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause, and the alert's degraded-health premise is contradicted by current observations. Handing off for evidence of actual degradation rather than asserting a root cause.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing an actual checkout failure or latency spike (error rate, p95, timeouts) to substantiate any degraded health
Per-service breakdown distinguishing gateway/order/payment/inventory behavior; current metrics are identical across services
Evidence of db pool waiters, dependency timeouts, or 5xx responses to test db-pool-exhaustion or http-500
Memory retention time series per service to test memory-leak
Deployment/configuration change records to test bad-configuration or downstream-latency
